title: Beyond Local Power: Functional Connectivity Analysis for Subject-Independent Learning Style Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2608.12000v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Identifying individual learning styles optimizes pedagogical efficacy. While traditional questionnaires are structured, behavioral tracking methods require prolonged interaction log accumulation. To overcome these temporal constraints, this paper proposes an objective Electroencephalography (EEG) approach evaluating Phase Locking Value (PLV) connectivity against localized features across the Active-Reflective (AR) and Verbal-Visual (VV) Felder-Silverman dimensions. EEG signals were recorded from 28 participants during Raven's Advanced Progressive Matrices tasks. Support Vector Machine classification used Leave-One-Subject-Out Cross-Validation (LOSO-CV) alongside a 70:30 intra-subject split. translated_title: 超越局部功率：基于功能连接分析的主体无关学习风格识别
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12000v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：识别个体学习风格可优化教学效果。虽然传统问卷具有结构化特点，但行为追踪方法需要长时间交互日志的积累。为克服这些时间限制，本文提出一种客观的脑电图（EEG）方法，评估相位锁定值（PLV）连接性与局部特征在主动-反思（AR）和言语-视觉（VV）Felder-Silverman维度上的表现。在瑞文高级渐进矩阵任务期间记录了28名参与者的EEG信号。支持向量机分类采用留一被试交叉验证（LOSO-CV）以及70:30的被试内分割。VV维度达到了70.00%的被试水平准确率，由明显的前额-枕叶极化驱动。相反，AR维度由于执行网络重叠和“系统性神经”特征，跨被试泛化性较低（55.56%）。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于EEG相位锁定值功能连接的分析方法，通过跨被试验证，在言语-视觉学习风格识别上达到70%的准确率，优于传统局部特征方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an EEG-based Phase Locking Value functional connectivity approach for subject-independent learning style recognition, achieving 70% accuracy in verbal-visual dimension via cross-subject validation, outperforming local feature methods.
